snippet.title: WIZORDUM | Coming to Consoles September 23 | Wishlist Now!
snippet.description:
🧙‍♂️ Play now on PC! ► http://wizordum.com/ 
Just announced at #gamescom! Wizordum, the retro-inspired fantasy FPS from Emberheart Games and Apogee Entertainment, is coming to Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and Nintendo Switch on September 23, 2025, in partnership with our friends at @atari and Infogrames!

Step into the boots of a powerful mage and explore vibrant, fast-paced levels that fuse classic ’90s shooters like DOOM, Hexen, Heretic, and Wolfenstein 3D with modern gameplay, polish, and replayability. Journey through sprawling levels filled with traps, puzzles, minecart mayhem, and deadly enemies, armed with an arsenal of magic weapons like the Faewood Crossbow, explosive Poison Vials, the elemental Staff of Chaos, and the devastating Grimoire.

Plus, unleash your creativity with Wizordum’s intuitive Level Editor, where you can import custom sprites and textures, build your own retro FPS adventures, or play countless maps made by the community.

Already a “Very Positive” hit on PC (Steam & GOG), Wizordum is bringing its spellcasting chaos to consoles for the first time.
Get ready to grab your wand, prepare for battle, and bring peace back to Terrabruma!
-

Voice-over by Tre Mosley
Music Composed by Tim Stoney
Using Themes from “Wizordum” by Tim Stoney
Executive Producer: Jeron Moore

WIZORDUM | Coming to Consoles September 23 | Wishlist Now!
